name: Wait for the final speech transcript before submitting speaking practice
description: SpeakingPracticeActivity submits when isListening becomes false even though the speech-recognition hook enters a processing state and may deliver the final transcript afterward, so the persisted attempt can use the last interim transcript.
acceptanceCriteria: A speaking-practice attempt is not submitted until speech recognition has produced its final transcript. A late final transcript replaces the interim text used for grading, while empty/cancelled/error paths remain bounded and submit at most once. Regression tests distinguish the stop-listening transition from final-transcript readiness.
